ns0:g.ns0:text: Multipass exchangers correct a counterflow reference LMTD
Schematic one-shell/two-tube-pass arrangement; baffles guide shell-side flow. Obtain F from the correlation/chart for the actual pass arrangement and
terminal temperatures. Do not use a counterflow LMTD with F=1 for arbitrary multipass geometry.
